note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Let release managers coordinate through addressed messages
purpose: Lets native release-manager sessions send addressed, durable messages and confirm them with an explicit acknowledgment. It also sets out a controlled handover of the Plan-manager role between sessions, plus optional mail checks for the coding tools that are off by default.
serves: The Project outcome of reliable coordination between managers, so the operator is not the only link between them.
done_when: Two isolated test managers exchange a request and a correlated reply through the coordination board, and a Plan-manager handover moves the role to one successor without leaving two current managers.

actions.title: Build the local addressed message board
actions.why: Gives managers one durable place to send and correlate addressed messages, with no duplicates on replay.
actions.done_when: Repeating the same message request yields one message and the same receipt, and a changed message with the same request id is refused.

actions.title: Prove a checkpoint roundtrip between isolated managers
actions.why: Shows two real native managers can send, acknowledge and answer through the board before anything relies on it.
actions.done_when: Two isolated test managers complete a nonce, acknowledgment, transform and correlated reply, with their identity, version and permissions recorded.

actions.title: Hand the Plan manager role over explicitly
actions.why: Stops two managers acting as current at once, which would leave unclear ownership of the Plan.
actions.done_when: Tests show a handover validates both sides, moves outstanding work to the successor and blocks the old session from further addressed reads, without performing a real transfer.

actions.title: Add an optional mail check for Claude Code
actions.why: Lets a Claude Code session see new mail during its work, if the operator turns the check on.
actions.done_when: An opt-in, off-by-default hook surfaces new mail for the session, and checks cheaply when there is none.

actions.title: Add an optional mail check for Codex
actions.why: Gives Codex sessions the same mail check, but only if it adds no material token cost.
actions.done_when: Codex's hook surfaces new mail the same way and ships only if its measurement shows an empty inbox costs no material tokens, otherwise the blocker is reported.

actions.title: Add an optional mail check for OpenCode
actions.why: Gives OpenCode sessions the same mail check, under the same cost condition.
actions.done_when: OpenCode's plugin surfaces new mail the same way and ships only if its measurement shows no material token cost, otherwise the blocker is reported.
